integrity: The graph-theoretic rank and stability statements are proved analytically from the source pair-response identity. Finite computations are corroborative only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the internal-marker calibration layer. It does not automatically transfer the source paper's complete geometric sample-complexity theorem to an arbitrary marker network, and it assumes the source pair identity is valid on every selected calibration edge.
title: Odd-cycle calibration networks for parity-superselected fermionic Lindbladian learning
